question: [句型转换] （三）按要求完成句子（每空一词）。 （1）I have already finished my homework.（改为否定句） I ______ finished my homework ______ . （2）Tom is a very clever boy.（改为感叹句） ______ ______ clever boy Tom is! （3）They built the bridge last year.（改为被动语态） The bridge ______ ______ last year. （4）He asked me, "Do you like English?"（改为宾语从句） He asked me ______ I ______ English. （5）The film began ten minutes ago.（用现在完成时改写） The film ______ ______ ______ for ten minutes.
answer: （1）haven't; yet　（2）What a　（3）was built　（4）if/whether; liked　（5）has been on
explanation: 【解析】句型转换要严格按要求，注意每空一词、语序与时态。

question: [书面表达] 学校英语俱乐部正在招募新成员。请你以「Join Us!」为题写一则招募启事。 提示：①活动内容：英语角、英语演讲比赛、看英文电影；②时间：每周五下午；③联系邮箱：englishclub@school.com。 要求：①80—100 词；②文中不得出现真实的人名、校名、地名；③可适当发挥。

参考范文（以第 4 篇为例）：
How to Protect the Environment
The environment is becoming worse and worse. As middle school students, we should do something to protect it.

If everyone makes a contribution, our world will be more and more beautiful. Let's take action right now!
